title: Shifter Quantization: Compact Representations for Native Integer Computation
abstract: arXiv:2611.33080v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Groupwise quantization is used in LLM quantization to improve accuracy at low bit widths, but grouping weights keeps standard integer MMA from spanning the full dot product for efficient GPU inference. We develop a new quantization method, Shifter Quantization (SQ), that reconstructs native-width integer operands by appending and shifting shared bits. To further extend the efficiency, we develop a special variant of SQ, Shifter Integer (SHI), to use INT4 kernels. We show that SQ and SHI formats perform better than standard groupwise quantization in quality, as measured by projection error and KL divergence, and in inference speed, as measured during decoding and prefill. For low precision like 2-bit quantization, SQ2 and SHI2 achieve 2.71-3.77x the 4,096-token prefill throughput of llama.cpp on a Q2_K checkpoint and reduce WikiText-2 KL by 6.6-7.8%. For mid precision like 4-bit quantization, SQ4 achieves 1.43-2.47x the prefill throughput

translated_title: 移位器量化：面向原生整数计算的紧凑表示
translated_abstract: 分组量化被用于大语言模型量化中，以在低位宽下提高精度，但对权重进行分组使得标准整数MMA（矩阵乘累加）无法跨越完整的点积进行运算，从而阻碍了高效的GPU推理。我们开发了一种新的量化方法——移位器量化（SQ），它通过追加和移位共享比特来重构原生宽度（原生整数宽度）的整数操作数。为了进一步提升效率，我们开发了SQ的一个特殊变体——移位整数（SHI），以使用INT4内核。我们表明，SQ和SHI格式在质量上（以投影误差和KL散度衡量）以及在推理速度上（在解码和预填充阶段测量）均优于标准的分组量化。对于像2比特量化这样的低精度场景，SQ2和SHI2在Q2_K检查点上实现了llama.cpp 4,096 token预填充吞吐量的2.71-3.77倍，并将WikiText-2 KL散度降低了6.6-7.8%。对于像4比特量化这样的中等精度场景，SQ4实现了1.43-2.47倍的预填充吞吐量。
tldr: 提出移位器量化（SQ）方法，通过追加和移位共享比特重构原生宽度整数操作数，使GPU整数矩阵运算能覆盖完整点积，在2比特精度下实现llama.cpp预填充吞吐量2.71-3.77倍的提升并降低KL散度。
en_tdlr: We propose Shifter Quantization (SQ), a novel method that reconstructs native-width integer operands by appending and shifting shared bits, enabling standard integer MMA to span the full dot product and achieving 2.71-3.77x prefill throughput over llama.cpp with lower KL divergence at 2-bit precision.
